sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly near-frontal man, short combed grey/white side-part hair/brows, white moustache only and clean chin, large black rounded-square glasses over eyes. Off-white broad-lapel lab coat, grey pointed shirt/charcoal inner sweater, cropped curved black/metal stethoscope tube at viewer-right coat edge. Serious mouth, blue background. Preserve accessories/hair/moustache/brows/clothes/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly near-frontal bald-crown man with white side hair/brows, round brown-rim glasses, white moustache and short full chin/jaw beard. Grey wide ribbed cardigan with pale horizontal stripes over pale collar and charcoal knit inner top; small gold nameplate viewer right, text unreadable. Serious mouth, blue background. Preserve bald crown/side hair, beard/glasses/nameplate/crop/light; short broad mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal clean-shaven stocky man, short wavy brown side-combed hair/brows. Brown broad-lapel field coat with shoulder tabs and small metallic laboratory-flask lapel pin viewer left, dark grey pointed shirt partly open with brown-gold buttons. Serious mouth and blue background. Preserve hair/brows/pin/clothing/crop/light; compact mascot head, short broad fitted neck, no added facial hair.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal clean-shaven stocky man, short neat brown side-part hair/brows. Burgundy-brown broad-lapel jacket, white pointed shirt/dark brown tie; source-cropped dark blue book/folder at viewer left with atom-style line symbol and small blue/green/orange index tabs. Serious mouth, blue background. Preserve hair/brows, book/symbol/tabs/clothes/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck, no invented text.
